lines.text: // Emoji_Presentation below U+1F000, from Unicode's emoji-data.txt: these draw as emoji without U+FE0F.
for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(EMOJI_PRESENTATION) / sizeof(EMOJI_PRESENTATION[0]); i++) {
if (first < 0x1f000 && next != VS16 && next != KEYCAP) return 0;
if (next == VS15 || (!emoji_by_default(first) && next != VS16 && next != KEYCAP)) return 0;
// Malformed UTF-8 decodes one byte at a time as VD_UTF8_REPLACEMENT.
// The bytes of the emoji cluster at text, with its codepoints in sequence, or 0 when text does not start one. A
// cluster starts at a codepoint from U+1F000 up or one followed by U+FE0F or a keycap mark, and takes skin tones,
// tags, a second regional indicator and ZWJ-joined codepoints.
// cluster starts at a codepoint from U+1F000 up, an emoji-style symbol like U+2728, or one followed by U+FE0F or a
// keycap mark; U+FE0E after it keeps it text. It takes skin tones, tags, a second regional indicator and ZWJ-joined
(const uint32_t[]){0x1f468, 0x200d, 0x1f469, 0x200d, 0x1f467}, 5, "a ZWJ sequence is one cluster");
"a trailing ZWJ is not part of the cluster");
expect_cluster("\xe2\x9c\xa8!", 3, (const uint32_t[]){0x2728}, 1, "an emoji-style symbol needs no U+FE0F");
expect_cluster("\xe2\x9c\xa8\xef\xb8\x8e", 0, NULL, 0, "U+FE0E keeps an emoji-style symbol text");
expect_cluster("\xe2\x86\x92", 0, NULL, 0, "an arrow is not an emoji");
// Pretends assets/emoji holds 1f3ae, 2764 and 1f468: 8x8 images, opaque red inside a transparent border.
